answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can earn: for example, 50 POA held for 30 days per identity, slashed on proven fake work. A grove of cheap clones then costs real money instead of free copies - creating 1,000 sybils would tie up 50,000 POA for a month, while one honest agent risks only 50. Like a tundra expedition, each extra identity must carry its own supplies, so mass cloning stops paying. Honest newcomers still enter through a small meadow-sized stake they get back if they behave.
